## Learning goals

By the end of this page:

- I will be able to start a computer from an approved Linux Mint USB installer.
- I will be able to complete and verify an approved installation without confusing the installer USB with the internal drive.

This is important because choosing the wrong drive can erase data.

## Before installation

1. Confirm the assigned computer, Linux Mint image, and installer USB.
2. Back up any files that must be kept.
3. Record the computer model and current drive information.
4. Start the live environment and test display, keyboard, mouse, sound, wired networking, and wireless networking.
5. Stop for teacher approval before opening the installer.

## Install and verify

Follow the [official Linux Mint Installation Guide](https://linuxmint-installation-guide.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) and the teacher's drive-partition instructions. Do not improvise around encryption, dual boot, BitLocker, redundant array settings, or unknown partitions.

After installation, verify that the computer starts without the USB, reaches the desktop, connects to the approved network, reports the expected storage, and can install updates.

Submit the requested installation record and photographs.
